message.content:
Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a well-defined rounded opacity in the left upper lung zone with an adjacent area of marked hyperlucency (air trapping) and contralateral mediastinal shift to the right. This constellation of findings is characteristic of a congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM) or similar mass lesion causing a ball-valve obstruction, leading to air trapping and respiratory distress.
